en.NO_ANSWER: Please answer completely before clicking submit.
en.READ_QT: Read the clock and fill the blanks.
en.SET_QT: Set the clock according to the given time.
en.READ_H_1: Identify the hour hand of the clock. The number it points to shows the hour.
en.READ_M_1: Identify the minutes hand of the clock. Check the number it is pointing to and carefully calculate the minutes.
en.READ_S_1: Identify the seconds hand of the clock. The number it points to shows the second.
en.SET_H_1: Identify the given hour. Choose the hour hand and make it to point at the required number.
en.SET_M_1: Identify the given minute. Calculate the number that represents that minute. Choose the minute hand and make it to point at the required number.
en.SET_S_1: Identify the given second. Choose the second hand and make it to point at the required number.
en.BETWEEN_SUC_NUMS: Between every successive numbers, there are 5 minutes.
en.TOTAL_MINUTES: Total number of minutes in an hour is 60.
en.TOTAL_SECONDS: Total number of seconds in a minute is 60.
